caption: swipe for the week the sky had. one of these is about your love life. dec 1 – 6, 2026.

slides.headline: what just happened in the *sky* this week?
a last quarter moon in *virgo* cleared the desk
slides.body: half-lit and shrinking. reads as a week for finishing, not starting.

slides.headline: *venus* walked into scorpio. small talk is over
slides.body: love in scorpio reads as all or nothing, and venus stays until january.

slides.headline: *mars* squared uranus: the urge to blow it all up
slides.body: mars in virgo met sudden uranus. quit something on a whim friday? sleep on it.

slides.headline: *mercury* entered sagittarius this morning
slides.body: conversations get louder and more honest until christmas day.

slides.headline: the one to watch: a *new moon* on tuesday
slides.body: sagittarius, 17°. decide what you want before it arrives.
